capture_policy: Public HTTPS primary sources captured in this arm on 2026-10-05 UTC. A capture proves bytes delivered, not semantic understanding or application behavior. `complete` indicates response body capture completeness.

sources.title: OME-NGFF specification
sources.locator: §3.3 Coordinate transformations; §3.4 Multiscales; axis names/order and recommended time/channel/spatial ordering
sources.applicability: Interoperable metadata precedent: transform list order, scale/translation, explicit axis metadata and multiscales arrays. v0.4 coordinate transform fields cited here are not a general arbitrary spatial affine; the standard does not prove reader/writer interoperability in this app.

sources.title: napari scale and unit-aware rendering
sources.pin: napari docs 0.9.2 (version switcher and docsearch version in captured page)
sources.locator: Sections ‘Scale and units live on layers’ and ‘Inheriting scale and units from xarray’
sources.applicability: Useful viewer-layer data-to-rendered-world transform and units model. Layer transforms alone are not durable project provenance or an app serialization contract.

sources.title: napari Dask and large dataset tutorial
sources.locator: Examples contrasting delayed whole-file imread with slice/time/channel access; contrast limits; reshape example causing 600 reads
sources.applicability: Shows access-pattern risks and lazy task examples in documentation. It does not establish 3 GB memory bounds, reader codec behavior or latency.

sources.title: napari threading guide
sources.locator: Section ‘Generators for the win!’ and worker events (aborted, paused, resumed, yielded)
sources.applicability: Worker yielding/progress/control pattern. No promise of cancelling a codec while a blocking native read is in progress.

sources.title: Bio-Formats documentation
sources.locator: Documentation overview; user/developer guides and format/version sections
sources.applicability: Supports pinning the reader family and recording its runtime/model context. Does not imply every camera/file variant is supported.

sources.title: Bio-Formats IFormatReader API
sources.locator: Methods openBytes(no,x,y,w,h), openPlane(no,x,y,w,h), getDimensionOrder(), isOrderCertain(), getAdvancedUsedFiles(), setNormalized(boolean)
sources.applicability: The API contracts include subregion reads and order certainty/associated-file queries; not proof each underlying reader avoids whole-plane decompression or meets target performance.

sources.title: QuPath projects guide
sources.locator: Project creation, image import/server selection, orientation behavior, missing-path resolution/relocation, project contents
sources.applicability: Useful project/path relocation and source-preserving view orientation precedent. QuPath expects an empty project folder and may overwrite project-owned files; proposal therefore does not copy its folder ownership behavior.

sources.title: QuPath image formats
sources.locator: Sections ‘Image files’, ‘Pyramidal images’, and format-specific reporting/caveat sections
sources.applicability: Documents distinct Bio-Formats and OpenSlide paths, OpenSlide's 2D 8-bit RGB restriction in this context, and variants/caveats. QuPath format behavior is not the proposed app's behavior.

sources.title: QuPath annotation export
sources.locator: ‘Units and origin’, ‘GeoJSON’, and ‘Labeled vs. Binary’ sections
sources.applicability: QuPath documents pixel origin/units, ellipse polygon conversion, and binary/label overlap tradeoffs. These are QuPath export semantics, not universal GeoJSON behavior.

sources.title: napari issue 4096: Adding points in 3D is wacky
sources.pin: napari issue #4096, opened against 0.4.13rc1-era development; issue artifact captured 2026-10-05
sources.locator: Issue body and initial reproduction: adding points to 2D points layer in 3D view has undefined/wacky placement
sources.applicability: Establishes a real interaction problem and reported context; issue body alone does not establish the fix.

sources.title: napari issue 4096 comments
sources.locator: Discussion of 2D layer in 3D mode and reference to merged fix #4184
sources.applicability: Links the report to intended behavior and the subsequent PR; comments are not themselves proof of released fix or regression coverage.

sources.title: napari PR 4184 API record
sources.pin: napari PR #4184, merged 2022-03-02, milestone 0.4.15; merge commit 4deba78a30062ccd097a5328d8f13a886d42e901
sources.applicability: Associates the repair with commit and 0.4.15 milestone. PR record alone does not demonstrate regression-test content; see diff and commit.

sources.title: napari PR 4184 patch
sources.locator: Change making a points layer non-editable when ndim < 3 and ndisplay == 3; test changes checking 2D editability before/after and 3D remains editable
sources.applicability: Patch explicitly contains implementation and regression assertions. Tests assert editability state, not geometry export or every transformed coordinate.

sources.title: napari merge commit 4deba78
sources.locator: Commit message and changed files including points layer tests
sources.applicability: Pins the integrated source change; commit metadata plus patch establishes what was integrated, not candidate execution of napari tests.

sources.title: napari 0.4.15 release
sources.locator: Bug-fix notes list block points add mode in 3D when layer.ndim == 2 (#4184)
sources.applicability: Closes the public issue→implementation/test→release chain for this fix. Does not establish current 0.9.2 runtime behavior or general 3D annotation correctness.

sources.title: SQLite atomic commit
sources.pin: SQLite public atomic commit documentation snapshot captured 2026-10-05; immutable body hash used as pin
sources.locator: §1 Introduction and rollback-mode atomic commit sequence; stated dependence on OS/filesystem locking and flush behavior
sources.applicability: Documents SQLite's atomic commit design and environmental assumptions. Does not guarantee behavior on the team's shared filesystem.

sources.title: SQLite write-ahead logging
sources.pin: SQLite public WAL documentation snapshot captured 2026-10-05; immutable body hash used as pin
sources.locator: §1 Overview and §2.2 Concurrency; same-host processes, network filesystem limitation, WAL/SHM and checkpoint behavior
sources.applicability: Supports avoiding live shared WAL databases. Snapshot exchange still needs testing against actual share semantics.

sources.title: napari points layer guide
sources.pin: napari docs 0.9.2 (docsearch version in captured page)
sources.locator: GUI point add/select/pan tools; multidimensional point slicing; documented keyboard shortcuts and 2D/3D behavior
sources.applicability: Only a region of this large page was read; the cited claims are from the inspected range. Supports point-layer mechanics/shortcuts; does not evidence durable project serialization or custom app accessibility.
